cli.adapter.unknown.help: built-in adapters: {known}; a project adapter is declared as local:adapters/x.mjs
cli.adapter.missing.help: check the path after local: (relative to the documentation project)
cli.adapter.import.help: fix the JavaScript syntax of the adapter
cli.adapter.invalid: {kind} adapter “{name}”: its default export has no {method}() function
cli.adapter.invalid.help: an adapter exports default { name, options, {method}(…) } (§5 of the kit's ARCHITECTURE.md)
cli.validate.target: a target needs exactly one of: {kinds} (found: {found})
cli.validate.target.help: for example { role: "button", name: "Save" }, { text: "Total" } or { css: "main" }
cli.validate.action: an action needs exactly one of: {kinds} (found: {found})
cli.validate.action.help: for example { click: { text: "Open" } }, { wait: 500 } or { press: "Escape" }
cli.connect.open: A {browser} window is open on {url}: sign in there (SSO and MFA work).
cli.connect.pressEnter: Once you are signed in, press Enter here (15 minutes at most).
cli.connect.detecting: The session is detected as soon as you are signed in (15 minutes at most).
cli.connect.notYet: not signed in yet (still on a sign-in page): finish signing in, then press Enter again.
cli.connect.secret: this file gives access to the application while it is valid: it is a secret, ignored by git. Never copy, show or share it.
cli.connect.forgetHint: Delete it when you are done: {command} connect --forget
cli.connect.noAuth: This application needs no sign-in (auth.adapter: "none"): nothing to do.
cli.connect.noUrl.help: set app.url in doc.config.mjs, or pass --url https://…
cli.connect.unreachable.help: check the address, and that the application is running
cli.connect.closed: the browser window was closed before the session was saved
cli.connect.closed.help: run {command} connect again, and press Enter once you are signed in
cli.connect.noTerminal: no terminal to press Enter in
cli.connect.noTerminal.help: run {command} connect in an interactive terminal, or use an adapter that detects the session (nextauth, api-me)
cli.capture.readOnlyDisabled: read-only is OFF although a session is used (capture.readOnly: false): write requests reach the application

cli.capture.prefetched.one: {n} prefetch request to forbidden routes aborted — {list}
cli.capture.prefetched.other: {n} prefetch requests to forbidden routes aborted — {list}

cli.capture.readOnlyOff: Read-only: off — write requests were not blocked.
cli.capture.forbidden.help: a write made by the server while it renders a page cannot be blocked by the browser: describe the page from its code, or reuse a record already opened and adjust capture.forbidden
cli.capture.noCaptures.help: add an entry to CAPTURES in a plan file
cli.capture.noMatch: no capture matches “{patterns}” ({n} in the plans)
cli.capture.noMatch.help: a pattern uses * for any characters, e.g. "use-*"
cli.capture.noUrl.help: set app.url in doc.config.mjs, or the DOC_KIT_URL variable
cli.capture.noSession.help: sign in with {command} connect; for a public application, set auth.adapter to "none" or pass --no-session
cli.capture.expiredDuring: the session expired during the run, at “{id}” (sign-in page: {url})
cli.capture.expiredDuring.help: run {command} connect, then capture the remaining ids again
cli.capture.signInRequired: “{id}”: the application asks to sign in ({url})
cli.capture.signInRequired.help: sign in first with {command} connect; for a public application, set auth.adapter to "none"
cli.capture.unreachable.help: check app.url, and that the application is running
cli.capture.plansMissing.help: create it (one .mjs file per batch of pages, exporting CAPTURES), or fix capture.plans or --plans
cli.capture.planImport.help: fix the JavaScript syntax of the plan
cli.capture.planModule.help: install the dependencies of the documentation project (npm install: it depends on the kit), or fix the import path
cli.capture.planNoExport.help: each file of the plans folder exports CAPTURES = [ … ]; shared helpers go in captures/targets.mjs
cli.capture.planInvalid.help: fix the entries listed below (file › id (CAPTURES[index]) › field): one invalid entry stops the command (syntax: engine/capture/plans.mjs in the kit)
cli.capture.duplicate.help: each id names an image: make it unique
cli.capture.error.forbiddenHit: the page requested a forbidden route ({path}): capture stopped
cli.capture.error.blockSelector: the { block } target needs capture.selectors.block in doc.config.mjs
cli.capture.error.unionHere: { union } is only allowed in a zone
cli.capture.error.challenge: stopped by a bot challenge ({url}): sign in again with the adapter's browser option set to "chrome"
cli.demo.noSetup.help: set capture.setup in doc.config.mjs: an idempotent script that prepares the demo data
cli.demo.missing.help: fix capture.setup (relative to the documentation project)
cli.demo.failed.help: read its messages above; the script must be idempotent: run it again once fixed
cli.check.coverage.none.help: add for example coverage: [{ adapter: "next-app-router", app: "../../app" }] to doc.config.mjs
cli.check.coverage.advice: cite each missing element in a page, or in the routes of the table of contents
cli.check.images.orphan: orphan image, cited by no page: {file}
cli.check.images.orphan.help: cite it (:::screen, ::capture, ::before-after) or delete it with its zone file
cli.check.images.zonesWithoutImage.help: take the capture again ({command} capture), or delete the zone file
cli.check.images.heavy.help: {command} optimize recompresses the images above the threshold
cli.check.images.outdated: {file}: captured on version {captured}, the application is at version {version}
cli.check.images.outdated.help: capture it again, or say on the page which version the screen shows
cli.check.secrets.found.help: remove the value from the source; if it shows in a screenshot, mask it (masks, masking.patterns) and capture again
cli.check.secrets.kind.assignment: value of a key, token or password
cli.check.secrets.sessionOutside: session file outside the session folder: {file}
cli.check.secrets.sessionOutside.help: delete it: a session gives access to the application ({command} connect keeps it in {dir})
cli.check.secrets.sessionTracked: the session file is tracked by git: {file}

cli.check.secrets.ok: ✔ No secret found ({files} source files, {places} places of the site).
